name: Settled Status Reason 2 Code
definition: Partial settlement status information or information about gating.

GATM.name: Gated Multiple NAV
GATM.definition: Redemption has been gated. Multiple redemptions and multiple prices will be required.

GAT1.name: Gated One NAV
GAT1.definition: Redemption has been gated, all settlement will be done at the same price.

UCPS.name: Units Cash Partially Settled
UCPS.definition: Units and cash are both partially settled.
